subject: Service-account claim snapshot & SAML assertion samples for SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <itops@medsync.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: prisec-audit@safeguard.com
Date: 2026-10-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 intake - service account claims and SAML samples

Hi Sergio,

We are kickstarting the SOC2 intake for MedSync and our auditor (Pranav at Safeguard) needs a compact snapshot of all service/principal accounts in our Redwood tenancy plus a few SAML assertion examples to validate assertion attributes. Specifically: 

- CSV list of service accounts (name, principal_id, owner, created_at, last_used_at, associated_role)
- A SCIM delta extract (if available) showing recent joins/leaves in the last 90 days
- 3 sample SAML assertion payloads (one for a regular user, one for a service account, one with elevated admin role) with redactions allowed for PII

Can you confirm you can deliver the artifacts by COB Thu 2026-10-15? Please indicate transfer method (SFTP, secure Drive link, or upload to the secure compliance folder). We may need evidence of owner attestation for any service accounts flagged as "shared".

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, IT Operations
MedSync Health

Attachment: none

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <itops@medsync.io>, prisec-audit@safeguard.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake - service account claims and SAML samples

Elena / Pranav —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide a scoped package that meets the auditor's ask. Plan: 

1) scim-delta-snapshot.csv — export of provisioning events for the last 90 days (format: principal_id, action, timestamp, source, changed_by).
2) scim-service-claims.csv — condensed roster of service/service-principal accounts with owner contact and last-used timestamp.
3) saml-assertion-samples.txt — three examples with non-sensitive fields preserved; we'll redact email addresses and PII.
4) access-mapping-matrix.xlsx — mapping of service accounts to roles and minimum privileges.

Questions / checklist items for you: 
- Do you accept a secure Google Drive link with restricted access for transfer, or do you require SFTP?
- For any service account that is "shared", we will need an owner attestation line (email reply suffices) stating purpose and rotation cadence.

Target delivery: Thu 2026-10-15 17:00 PT. Jordan / Naomi — can you assemble the CSVs and produce the SAML samples? Jordan, please include notes about any accounts with missing owners. Naomi, please validate role mappings. I will collate and redact PII before transfer.

Sergio Alvarez
Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim-delta-snapshot.csv (stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, Elena Ruiz <itops@medsync.io>, prisec-audit@safeguard.com
Date: 2026-10-13T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake - service account claims and SAML samples

On Wed, Oct 13, 2026 at 11:03 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena / Pranav —
> 
> Thanks for the clear list. We can provide a scoped package that meets the auditor's ask. Plan: 

Thanks — I'll take point on the service-account roster and the owner outreach. A few operational notes: 

- We'll include a column `owner_verified` with timestamps when we get confirmations. If owners don't reply within 48 hours, we'll mark `owner_pending` and include mitigation notes.
- For transfer, secure Drive with viewer-only links + enforced domain restriction is fine for MedSync; if Safeguard wants SFTP, tag that in your reply and we'll push to SFTP.
- Naomi: I saw ~12 service principals flagged with long-unused keys (>180 days). Recommend we include a short remediation plan for those.

I'll upload a working spreadsheet to the secure compliance Drive folder and share the link once I have the first pass.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Exec, Compliance Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: access-mapping-matrix.xlsx (working copy - stub)

From: Pranav Mehta <prisec-audit@safeguard.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Ruiz <itops@medsync.io>
Date: 2026-10-14T16:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake - service account claims and SAML samples

Sergio / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and proposed artifacts. Drive link is acceptable as long as access is restricted and we receive a short integrity checklist (hash or file-size confirmation) for large CSVs. A couple of follow-ups before we close the intake: 

- We will want one assertion sample that demonstrates an OIDC/SAML assertion with a role claim mapping to an ephemeral admin role (rotated keys). If you can include rotation cadence and last-rotation timestamp for service accounts with elevated privileges, that will expedite our review.
- For any accounts listed as "shared", please include the mitigation steps (who rotates, how often keys are rotated, and when the last attestation occurred).

If you can deliver the package and the attestation replies by EOD Friday 2026-10-16, we'll be able to keep the audit timeline intact. Thanks — we'll confirm receipt once the Drive link is shared.

—Pranav
Manager, Security Assurance
Safeguard Audit Partners

Forwarded message header: Received attachments: saml-assertion-samples.txt (stub)
